definitions.gloss: the Hinomaru; the Japanese national flag
definitions.explanation: The national flag of Japan, featuring a red circle on a white background. The red circle represents the sun.

examples.japanese: {日|ひ}の{丸|まる}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{揺|ゆ}れている→揺れる：01161_yureru⟧。
examples.english: The Hinomaru is swaying in the wind.

examples.japanese: ⟦オリンピック→オリンピック：09899_orinpikku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{日|ひ}の{丸|まる}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{掲|かか}げられた→掲げる：12791_kakageru⟧。
examples.english: The Hinomaru was raised at the Olympics.

examples.japanese: {日|ひ}の{丸|まる}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{白|しろ}→白：13854_shiro⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{赤|あか}→赤：02842_aka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{象徴|しょうちょう}→象徴：05534_shouchou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧だ。
examples.english: The white and red of the Hinomaru are colors that symbolize Japan.

notes:
{日|ひ}の{丸|まる} is the common everyday name for Japan's national flag, a red disc on a white background representing the sun. The name literally means "circle of the sun" — from ⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ (sun) + ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + ⟦{丸|まる}→丸：02167_maru⟧ (circle).

FORMAL NAME:
The official name is {日章旗|にっしょうき} (Flag of the Sun). {日|ひ}の{丸|まる} is the informal name used in daily conversation.

CULTURAL NOTE:
The Hinomaru has been used as a symbol of Japan for centuries. It was officially designated as the national flag in 1999 by the Act on National Flag and Anthem.
